equations: u_t = D_u lap(u) + gamma*(a - u + u^2 v)
v_t = D_v lap(v) + gamma*(b - u^2 v)

specimen.title: Holstein Cow (22815045791).jpg
specimen.credit: Province of Ontario Picture Bureau slide, c.1920; Community Archives of Belleville and Hastings County (Flickr CABHC 22815045791), via Wikimedia Commons
specimen.roi_note: Rectangular flank ROIs in image fractions, chosen to cover the torso coat while excluding head, legs and most background; thresholded by Otsu within each ROI. A single historical photograph of one animal: n=1, sepia, no scale bar. ROI sensitivity is reported via the second, tighter ROI.

claim_boundary.reported_in_source: Murray (1981) proposed an RD pre-pattern for mammalian coat markings and derived scale-dependent pattern classes; Turing (1952) derived the diffusion-driven instability.
claim_boundary.reconstructed_in_script: Schnakenberg dispersion relation, critical wavenumber/wavelength, equal-diffusion control, nonlinear spot simulation, and patch morphometrics on the specimen photograph.
claim_boundary.transfer_boundary: Dimensionless simulation units are compared to the photograph only through scale-free statistics (coverage, component counts, diameters normalised by ROI width).
claim_boundary.does_not_claim: Does not claim cow spotting is (or is not) developmentally caused by these morphogens; tests only whether a single-wavelength Turing pattern is morphometrically consistent with this flank. Does not generalise from n=1 animal/breed.
claim_boundary.multi_specimen_note: Pass 6 (2026-10-26): 9 additional Holstein specimens (this list) are HELD OUT from all Pass 1-5 fitting; model parameters fitted on specimen 01 are evaluated on them unchanged.
